Game Overview

PinoBlu is a arcade game built around guide Pino on his quirky culinary quest in a charming pixelated world. Devour heads to satisfy his cravings while dodging dangerous credit cards. Spend coins for delightful customizations as challenges escalate. Can you keep Pino alive and stylish in this retro-fun adventure?
